options.A: \(i\) and \(-i\) each has exactly one square root
options.B: \(i\) has two square roots but \(-i\) does not have any
options.C: neither \(i\) nor \(-i\) has any square root
options.D: \(i\) and \(-i\) each has exactly two square roots
